# Personal Coding Preferences

Mandatory:

- Do not rename variables, methods, classes, fields, DTOs, or packages unless explicitly requested.
- Follow requested scope exactly.
- Prefer simple and readable code.
- Avoid over-engineering.
- Provide complete methods instead of partial snippets.
- When multiple changes are required, provide the complete file.
- Do not introduce unrelated refactoring.
- Preserve existing project conventions.
- Use secure coding practices.
- Validate all external input.
- Use JUnit 5 and Mockito for tests.
- Verify using mvn clean verify whenever applicable.
